def interp1d(dst_n, src_n):
    s = ((torch.arange(dst_n).float() + 0.5) / scale - 0.5).clamp(0, src_n - 1)
    i0 = s.floor().long().clamp(0, src_n - 1)
    i1 = (i0 + 1).clamp(0, src_n - 1)

    T[torch.arange(dst_n), i1] += w1
    return T  # (dst, src)

def forward(module, x):

    if squeeze:
        x = x.unsqueeze(0)
    N, C, H, W = x.shape
    xr = x.reshape(N*C, H, W)

    k = torch.tensor([[0.25, 0.5, 0.25],

    y = torch.nn.functional.conv2d(z, k, groups=C, padding=1)
    return y.squeeze(0) if squeeze else y
